question: A jeep travels 80 km at the speed of 40 km/hr and the next 36 km at the speed of 18 km/hr. What is its average speed (in km/hr)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = 80 + 36 = 116 km

Total Time = (80 ÷ 40) + (36 ÷ 18) = 2 + 2 = 4 hr

Average Speed = 116 ÷ 4 = 29 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 29 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 D = 80 km
 S = 40 km/hr
 T = 2 hr

 D = 36 km
 S = 18 km/hr
 T = 2 hr

 

 Total D = 116 km | Total T = 4 hr

**Given:**

Distance 1 (d₁) = 80 km

Speed 1 (s₁) = 40 km/hr

Distance 2 (d₂) = 36 km

Speed 2 (s₂) = 18 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time for 1st part = 80 ÷ 40 = 2 hours

⇒ Time for 2nd part = 36 ÷ 18 = 2 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 80 + 36 = 116 km

⇒ Total Time = 2 + 2 = 4 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 116 ÷ 4 = 29 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 29 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

If a person covers equal distances at speeds x and y, then Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed (Equal Times)

If a person travels for equal time intervals at speeds x and y, then Average Speed = (x + y) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. In opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.
